claim_scope_note: Product-local PRINCIPLED-SUPPORT-WIDENING safety/coverage certificate for the byte-identical installed carrier (git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796 / sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72, ALREADY the shipping kernel src/spider/kernel.py). It is the EXACT mandate licensed by request.json#director_mandate.allocation (REOPEN C-PARAM-INHERIT; parent_handoff_disposition=SUPERSEDE; reason=global-director-REOPEN). It does NOT re-run the parent safety certificate (EXP-PRODUCT-38189918141), does NOT re-run readiness (EXP-PRODUCT-38186502935), does NOT test a substituted carrier, and does NOT fund/run the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark. Measured object: whether ONE frozen, purely data-driven support-widening rule (widen_support, the best simple homogeneous-run absorption of the shipped single-observation-length suffix), applied to the SAME shipped carrier mechanisms and run through the shipped resolve()/execute() path, generalizes SAFELY (zero false accepts, zero HTTP on out-of-grammar) while raising coverage toward 1.0 across declared identifier grammars. The widening rule is a candidate PROPOSAL injected in-run as the mechanism verification_rule support descriptor; it is NOT shipped and promotion would require a separate implementation+regression packet. READ-ONLY: the runner never writes src/spider/ or any freeze artifact (proved by V8 clause C over six hashed artifacts). C-PARAM-INHERIT stays EXPERIMENTAL and C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE stays HYPOTHESIS in ALL branches; NO claim advance and NO product promotion is authorized. No economics are measured (model_calls=0, model_tokens=0 by construction).
question: With the now-shipped carrier (src/spider/kernel.py: distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute), can the parameterized mechanism be widened SAFELY beyond the single-observation-length value it was distilled from to a DECLARED multi-digit/identifier grammar, raising support coverage toward 1.0 while holding ZERO false accepts and never executing a refusal case at the frozen confidence gate? Concretely, on four frozen families with independent localhost 200/404 oracles and a frozen declared-grammar label rule (A item /api/items/item-[0-9]{3}, B account /api/accounts/acct-[0-9]{4}, C doc /api/docs/doc-[0-9]{1,4}, D region /api/regions/region-00[0-9]): (Q1-IDENTITY) is src/spider/kernel.py byte-identical to the frozen carrier and does the induction path reproduce the expected shipped supports ^item\-00[0-9]{1}$, ^acct\-000[0-9]{1}$, ^doc\-0[0-9]{1}$, ^region\-00[0-9]{1}$? (Q2-LIVENESS) does the widened treatment become EXECUTABLE (treatment liveness)? (Q3-SAFETY) does T-WIDENED-PRINCIPLED bind ZERO out-of-declared-grammar payloads (M-T-WIDENED-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT==0), issue ZERO HTTP on any out-of-grammar payload (M-T-WIDENED-HTTP-ON-OUT==0) and never execute a refused case (M-T-WIDENED-REFUSAL-EXECUTED-COUNT==0)? (Q4-COVERAGE) how far does coverage rise versus the shipped baseline (M-COVERAGE-DELTA) and does it reach 1.0? (Q5-BOUNDARY) exactly which families are safe+complete, safe+incomplete, or unsafe, and is the unsafe case an identifiability limit (a declared grammar whose shared prefix run is semantically pinned but observationally indistinguishable from a varying run) rather than a bug? (Q6-UPPERBOUND) does the declared-grammar comparator B-DECLARED-FULL achieve zero false accepts AND coverage 1.0 on the same bank, i.e., does a safe+complete support exist at all? Report coverage before/after, false-accept count and any refusal that executed.
hypothesis: The shipped carrier's support inference is over-narrow because it greedily consumes shared digits into the literal prefix (item-001..005 -> ^item\-00[0-9]{1}$). The frozen data-driven widening rule widen_support absorbs the maximal trailing run of the common prefix that lies in the SAME character class as the observed varying remainder while preserving the observed uniform width. Expected: (H1-LIVENESS) T-WIDENED is EXECUTABLE on every training id and the induced shipped supports equal the frozen constants (induction path intact). (H2-UNIFORM) on FAM-A and FAM-B the rule recovers exactly the declared grammar (^item\-[0-9]{3}$, ^acct\-[0-9]{4}$): zero false accepts AND coverage 1.0. (H3-VARIABLE) on FAM-C the observed width is 2 so the rule yields ^doc\-[0-9]{2}$, which is a strict subset of the declared 1..4-digit grammar: zero false accepts but coverage < 1.0 (safe+incomplete). (H4-PINNED/SAFETY) on FAM-D the observed varying remainder spans the full digit class but the declared grammar pins the shared run (region-00[0-9]); the rule yields ^region\-[0-9]{3}$ and therefore binds the declared-negative ids region-010..region-999: M-T-WIDENED-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT == 9 and M-T-WIDENED-HTTP-ON-OUT == 9. Because a purely data-driven rule cannot distinguish a pinned shared run from a coincidental one, H4 implies the widening is NOT unconditionally safe and the overall packet outcome is FALSIFIES/WIDENING_UNSAFE, while H2/H3 give the exact condition and the B-DECLARED-FULL comparator shows the safe+complete upper bound is otherwise attainable. Frozen DESIGN point-predictions (value-level predicates only, no treatment resolve()): B-SHIPPED FA=0 coverage 32/63=0.5079; T-WIDENED FA=9 coverage 53/63=0.8413; B-DECLARED-FULL FA=0 coverage 1.0.
falsifier: FALSIFIES (valid scientific negative, status=COMPLETE) of the UNSAFE-WIDENING hypothesis if, on a verified carrier identity, T-WIDENED-PRINCIPLED has M-T-WIDENED-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT == 0 AND M-T-WIDENED-HTTP-ON-OUT == 0 AND M-T-WIDENED-REFUSAL-EXECUTED-COUNT == 0 across ALL four families INCLUDING FAM-D; then the data-driven widening is safe on this bank and decision is MIXED (safe+incomplete, FAM-C) or SUPPORTS (safe+complete). Separately, the widening-safety claim is SUPPORTED (FALSIFIES branch of the packet) if T-WIDENED binds >=1 out-of-declared-grammar payload or issues >=1 HTTP on one, in which case decision=WIDENING_UNSAFE and the exact offending bids/family become the specification of the required independent grammar/applicability guard. Low coverage ALONE (false_accept_count==0 but false_reject_count>0) does NOT falsify safety; it maps to MIXED. MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED (NEVER FALSIFIES) for: shipping kernel sha != 718efa6a (substituted carrier); V8 freeze-binding mismatch; induced shipped support != frozen constant (M-SUPPORT-IDENTITY FAIL, induction drift); M-REGRESSION < 3/3; PC-DETERMINISM-REPEAT mismatch; PC-EXACT-REPLAY < 25/25; B-LITERAL-KERNEL unexpectedly exposing distill_parameterized; a sensitivity gate failing (PC-UNSAFE-COARSE FA==0 OR PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN FA==0 meaning the detector is blind, OR NC-REJECT-ALL accept!=0/HTTP!=0); missing git objects or oracle/fixture failure.

positive_control.description: Detector-sensitivity positive control: the SAME installed carrier mechanisms with support replaced by the carrier's OWN coarse fallback sentinel __COARSE__ (accepts any non-empty string without whitespace or '/'). A safety oracle that never fires is useless, so this arm MUST produce at least one false accept on the frozen bank. Uses no new code: __COARSE__ is the shipped _COARSE_SUPPORT constant. A SECOND sensitivity control, PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN, replaces support with ^<id_prefix>\-[0-9]+$ (open width) and must also false-accept >=1 wrong-width id, proving the bank discriminates support width and not only the coarse fail-open sentinel.
positive_control.expected_behavior: PC-UNSAFE-COARSE false_accept_count >= 1 (frozen DESIGN point-prediction: 153) AND PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN false_accept_count >= 1 (frozen DESIGN point-prediction: 33). If either is 0, the safety metric cannot be trusted -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (never FALSIFIES).

It must accept nothing and issue no HTTP, anchoring the low end of M-T-WIDENED-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT and M-T-WIDENED-HTTP-ON-OUT so the certificate's zero is meaningful (not an artifact of a broken resolver).

measurement_validity: V1-DETERMINISM: each oracle is a stdlib http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1:0 (ephemeral port) returning fixed JSON {'type':<resource>,'id':<id>,'data':'res:'+<id>} 200 iff /api/<resource_plural>/<declared id> matches the family declared grammar, else 404; no RNG, no wall-clock, no external network, no model. widen_support is a pure function of the frozen training ids; the whole evaluation runs twice and asserts identical treatment/shipped/declared metrics, identical support identity and identical mechanism identity (port-invariant; mechanism_id excluded).

V2-CREDENTIAL-FREE + MODEL-FREE: no model calls and no browser actions; only loopback 127.0.0.1. The oracle's request counter is the authoritative HTTP measure (http_delta per record). model_calls == 0 and model_tokens == 0 by construction.

V3-IDENTITY-PREMISE-GATE: src/spider/kernel.py must have sha256 == CARRIER_SHA256 718efa6a... on a git-clean tree. Any other state (e.g. literal 46929b3a...) means the carrier was substituted -> BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID with the exact reason, NEVER FALSIFIES.

V4-STOP-TRIGGER (parent handoff do_not_assume): if the shipping-path identity is not the frozen carrier, or the induced shipped supports differ from the frozen constants, the runner stops BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID before any outcome measurement; the bank is never measured against a substituted/drifted carrier and the parent certificate/readiness measurement is never re-run.

V5-BANK-CONSTRUCTIBILITY + LABEL RULE (frozen, DESIGN-validated): 292 unique-bid items. Ground-truth label rule (DECLARED grammar under the fixed task schema): IN iff value is a str fullmatching the family declared regex AND intent == family intent AND context == {resource_type:<resource>,authenticated:true} AND params == {<resource>: value}; otherwise OUT. DESIGN validation: 63 IN / 229 OUT; FAM-A 16/56, FAM-B 18/55, FAM-C 19/53, FAM-D 10/65; the OUT set spans wrong-length, alpha, hex, case, separator, whitespace, injection, query/fragment/percent, unicode, other-prefix, oversized, non-string types, context/intent/param mismatch, and (FAM-D only) wrong-subrange same-class ids region-010..999 that the widened rule is expected to over-accept.

V6-REFUSAL-SEMANTICS: every refusal must have bound_action None, a non-empty reason, status != EXECUTABLE and ZERO HTTP (http_delta == 0). M-T-WIDENED-REFUSAL-EXECUTED-COUNT counts OUT items with status != EXECUTABLE and http_delta > 0 and MUST be 0 (structural invariant of resolve(): bound_action is only set on EXECUTABLE). Any violation is a validity anomaly.

V7-BOUNDARY-HONESTY: the packet reports per-family safety and coverage separately and never conflates 'safe' (false_accept_count == 0) with 'complete' (coverage == 1.0); the widening rule's exact support per family (M-WIDENED-SUPPORT-BY-FAMILY) and the exact offending false-accept bids are reported.

V8-FREEZE-BINDING (EXECUTE mode): (A) sha256(prereg.md) == freeze.json.hashes['prereg.md']; (B) the running orchestration source (__file__) equals the FROZEN RUNNER block inside the hash-bound prereg.md (normalized only for trailing newline and CRLF); (C) sha256 of EVERY artifact in freeze.json.artifact_hashes matches (SIX artifacts incl. src/spider/kernel.py, never mutated). Missing freeze.json in EXECUTE mode, or any mismatch, is BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Probe mode (EXP_PROBE_MODE=1) records UNBOUND-RUN and never fabricates the check.

V9-REGRESSION: tests/test_kernel.py must pass 3/3 on the as-installed shipping path with src on sys.path. A discovery result with < 3 tests or any failure/error is a validity gate failure (MEASUREMENT_INVALID).

V10-ABLATION-ATTRIBUTION: B-LITERAL-KERNEL is loaded from the frozen literal git blob in a hermetic temp package with the same shipped models/registry/init; if it exposes distill_parameterized the attribution logic is broken and the packet is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

V11-CONTROL-SENSITIVITY (non-vacuous oracle): PC-UNSAFE-COARSE FA >= 1 AND PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN FA >= 1 AND NC-REJECT-ALL accept_count == 0 AND http_total == 0; otherwise the certificate's zero is uninformative and the packet is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

V12-TREATMENT-EQUIVALENCE (why support override == widened inference): mechanism_id is a hash of {intent, template, slots} and is INDEPENDENT of the support descriptor; the only support-dependent downstream behaviour is verification_rule['parameter_supports'] consumed by resolve()'s _support_accepts. Replacing each induced support with widen_support(observed training segment values) is therefore exactly equivalent to re-running distill_parameterized with its internal _infer_support replaced by widen_support (verified at DESIGN by the induction-path probe), while keeping the shipped bytes untouched.

decision_rule.primary_metric: M-T-WIDENED-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT (T-WIDENED-PRINCIPLED count of OUT-labelled bank items whose resolve() status == EXECUTABLE), co-primary M-T-WIDENED-HTTP-ON-OUT (total HTTP issued on OUT-labelled items) and M-T-WIDENED-REFUSAL-EXECUTED-COUNT (refused items that nonetheless issued HTTP).

gates.validity_gate: ALL of V8-FREEZE-BINDING, M-IDENTITY, M-SUPPORT-IDENTITY, M-REGRESSION (3/3), PC-DETERMINISM-REPEAT, PC-EXACT-REPLAY (25/25) and B-LITERAL-KERNEL must PASS; otherwise status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE (instrument failure, never a negative).
gates.sensitivity_gate: PC-UNSAFE-COARSE false_accept_count >= 1 AND PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN false_accept_count >= 1 AND NC-REJECT-ALL accept_count == 0 AND NC-REJECT-ALL http_total == 0; otherwise status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE (vacuous/blind oracle).

WIDENING_UNSAFE.definition: T-WIDENED false_accept_count > 0 OR T-WIDENED http_on_out_label > 0 OR T-WIDENED refusal_executed_count > 0 on a verified carrier.
WIDENING_UNSAFE.outcome: FALSIFIES (status=COMPLETE): the purely data-driven widening is NOT unconditionally safe; the exact offending bids and the unsafe family/families are reported, the per-family boundary identifies the condition (declared grammar with an observationally-ambiguous pinned shared run), and the finding requires an independent grammar/applicability guard before any shipped widening. The product must ship conservative (no automatic widening). Frozen DESIGN point-prediction: FAM-D region-010..999 (9 false accepts).

WIDENING_SAFE_AND_COMPLETE.definition: T-WIDENED false_accept_count == 0 AND http_on_out_label == 0 AND refusal_executed_count == 0 AND coverage == 1.0.
WIDENING_SAFE_AND_COMPLETE.outcome: SUPPORTS (status=COMPLETE): the data-driven widening is both safe and complete on the declared bank; a safe+complete widening exists (also demonstrated by B-DECLARED-FULL).

WIDENING_SAFE_BUT_INCOMPLETE.definition: T-WIDENED false_accept_count == 0 AND http_on_out_label == 0 AND refusal_executed_count == 0 AND coverage < 1.0.
WIDENING_SAFE_BUT_INCOMPLETE.outcome: MIXED (status=COMPLETE): the widening is safe but leaves declared ids refused (e.g., variable-width FAM-C); report the per-family shortfall versus B-DECLARED-FULL.

decision_rule.overall_outcome_mapping: Precedence: MEASUREMENT_INVALID > FALSIFIES > (SUPPORTS vs MIXED). status=BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID if V8/identity/support-identity/validity/sensitivity/infrastructure fails (never a negative). Else status=COMPLETE with outcome FALSIFIES (WIDENING_UNSAFE) if any false accept or out-of-grammar HTTP or refusal execution; SUPPORTS if safe and coverage==1.0; otherwise MIXED (WIDENING_SAFE_BUT_INCOMPLETE).

decision_rule.reachability: The outcome mapping is total and its branches correspond to distinguishable measurements. FALSIFIES is reachable and is the frozen DESIGN point-prediction (value-level probe: T-WIDENED FA=9, all FAM-D wrong-subrange ids region-010..999; the bank is designed to realize over-acceptance of a pinned homogeneous run, and PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN independently shows the metric can fire). MIXED is reachable in the same decision function (0 FA + coverage<1; it is the counterfactual if FAM-D had not over-accepted) and is the frozen DESIGN prediction for T restricted to FAM-A/B/C (FA=0, coverage<1). SUPPORTS is reachable by the measurement framework (the completeness upper anchor; B-DECLARED-FULL achieves FA=0 and coverage 1.0 on the same bank, so a safe+complete support is realizable and the branch is not vacuous), though the frozen treatment is not expected to select it. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via substituted carrier, support drift, tampered freeze artifact, or a failing validity/sensitivity gate. DESIGN probes (value-level predicates and the induction path only; NO treatment resolve() over the bank was run) confirmed: widen_support(['item-001'..'item-005'])=^item\-[0-9]{3}$, =['acct-0001'..'acct-0005'] ^acct\-[0-9]{4}$, =['doc-01'..'doc-05'] ^doc\-[0-9]{2}$, =['region-000'..'region-009'] ^region\-[0-9]{3}$; bank 292 items/63 IN/229 OUT/unique bids; and the per-arm false-accept/coverage arithmetic above.
decision_rule.claim_status_semantics: C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL and C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE remains HYPOTHESIS in ALL branches. WIDENING_UNSAFE/FALSIFIES is a bounded Product-local negative about ONE candidate inference rule (the shipped carrier's causal parametrized path is unchanged and the registered next_gate -- the four-arm cold/instructions/retrieval comparison -- remains unmet and unfunded); WIDENING_SAFE_AND_COMPLETE/SUPPORTS or WIDENING_SAFE_BUT_INCOMPLETE/MIXED would be supporting evidence for the abstention/coverage property but do NOT discharge that gate. No branch advances or promotes any claim.

product_consequence_positive: If T-WIDENED is safe (M-T-WIDENED-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT == 0 and HTTP-on-OUT == 0) then the data-driven widening can raise coverage from the shipped 32/63=0.5079 toward 1.0 (SUPPORTS) or a documented partial level (MIXED), licensing a shipped widening (subject to a separate implementation+regression packet) and making the eventual treatment arm non-degenerate against strong cold/retrieval baselines. B-DECLARED-FULL would show the safe+complete ceiling is attainable, so any residual shortfall is attributable to information lost by purely data-driven inference rather than the bank.
product_consequence_negative: If any family is unsafe (FALSIFIES/WIDENING_UNSAFE), the purely data-driven homogeneous-run widening must NOT be shipped: the runner reports exactly which declared grammar is over-accepted (expected FAM-D region-010..region-999), so the product ships conservative (keeps the shipped over-narrow support) and the finding becomes the specification for an independent grammar/applicability guard (ingested declared grammar, or a pre-bind verification/repair step) that a future packet must implement and regression-test. No external agent may consume an auto-widened support on the basis of this packet. BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID -> the question cannot be assessed; the exact operational blocker is recorded (substituted carrier, support drift, freeze-binding mismatch, missing git objects, vacuum controls). Infrastructure/measurement failure is never repackaged as a scientific negative. In every branch C-PARAM-INHERIT stays EXPERIMENTAL, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE stays HYPOTHESIS, and the four-arm benchmark remains unfunded.

expected_information_gain: High and decision-relevant in both directions, and the smallest decisive Product-local batch on the shipped bytes that directly answers the Director's REOPEN question. It is the first measurement to run the shipped resolve()/execute() path over a multi-family declared-identifier bank with a frozen data-driven widening candidate, four independent declared grammars, a frozen grammar label rule, per-family safety/coverage decomposition, TWO sensitivity positive controls (coarse fail-open and overwide open-width), a null floor, and a strong declared-grammar upper-bound comparator. Either way it closes the parent's named unknown (whether the over-conservative boundary can be removed without reopening safety), identifies the exact identifiability obstruction, and does not fund or advance the externally gated four-arm benchmark.

A detector that never fires would yield a meaningless zero false-accept count, so both >=1 requirements are pre-established by probe.
